articles.title: Arteta warns Arsenal players against Fantasy Premier League leaks
articles.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has cautioned his squad to avoid inadvertently disclosing confidential team information through Fantasy Premier League activities. The warning comes as clubs increasingly monitor digital platforms and player engagement to prevent tactical advantages from leaking to opponents ahead of crucial fixtures in the domestic campaign.

articles.title: Southampton head coach Tonda Eckert signs contract extension
articles.summary: Southampton have secured the services of head coach Tonda Eckert after he agreed to a new contract keeping him at the club until 2029. The decision reflects the club's confidence in his long-term vision and leadership following a period of steady development and competitive performances under his guidance.

articles.title: Celtic midfielder Mika Baur sidelined with ankle injury
articles.summary: Celtic midfielder Mika Baur is facing approximately 10 weeks on the sidelines due to ankle ligament damage. Manager Martin O'Neill confirmed the setback, which deals a significant blow to the squad's depth during a busy period of domestic and European fixtures.

articles.title: Thomas Frank expresses delight upon joining Crystal Palace
articles.summary: Thomas Frank has spoken of his excitement at returning to managerial duties after being appointed at Crystal Palace. During his first press conference, the charismatic coach expressed his enthusiasm for the new challenge and his eagerness to make an immediate impact in the Premier League.

articles.title: Bukayo Saka faces lengthy layoff with thigh injury
articles.summary: Arsenal forward Bukayo Saka may not feature again before Christmas as he continues his recovery from a thigh injury sustained against Bayern Munich. Manager Mikel Arteta confirmed that recent assessments revealed no surgery is required, though the England international has not yet resumed light training.

articles.title: UEFA hands England suspended away ticket ban over chants
articles.summary: UEFA has imposed a suspended one-match ban on England away ticket sales and fined the Football Association 15,000 euros following discriminatory chanting by supporters during the Nations League victory over Spain. The punishment remains suspended for a two-year probationary period.

articles.title: OL Lyonnes defeat Arsenal in Women's Champions League
articles.summary: Arsenal's ambitions of securing an automatic top-four finish in the Women's Champions League suffered a blow following a defeat to OL Lyonnes. Goals from Jule Brand and Melchie Dumornay secured the victory for the French side, who remain joint-top of the group phase without conceding a goal.

articles.title: England drawn against Norway in Nations League
articles.summary: England will face Erling Haaland's Norway side in the quarter-finals of the Nations League. The upcoming fixture presents a major test for the national team as they look to advance further in the prestigious international tournament.

articles.title: Drone operator removes leaked Manchester United training footage
articles.summary: The individual responsible for uploading unauthorized drone footage of Mauricio Pochettino's initial training session at Manchester United has removed the video and issued an apology. The incident had sparked security and privacy concerns surrounding the club's new coaching setup.

articles.title: Rassie Erasmus faces potential ban over online watchalong
articles.summary: South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus is at risk of breaching his ongoing six-Test touchline ban if he proceeds with plans to host an online watchalong during the upcoming international fixture against Ireland. Rugby authorities are closely monitoring the situation.
